old_note: Provisional machine alignment by Codex (GPT-6), independent Tibetan-first proposal. The two white occurrences distinguish intrinsic and resultant whiteness. First rgyud gcig la belongs to unmixedness with afflicted things: mental stream / in question / within; second belongs to unmixedness with suffering: mental stream / one / with. The three with occurrences are, respectively, first dang, third la, and second dang. First ma dres is the established unmixed compound with tighter negative and positive members; second ma and dres own not and mixed together. The nominal rnam smin owns result, and the yielding verb owns ripens forth. zhing is omitted as distributed coordination, not nulled. The source spelling DRES BA’I is preserved and separately proposed as LOW/PROBABLE for review; the stem alone is banked. GMR English is verbatim; no hgm_gloss is changed.
